pose.name: ready
pose.why: Where the full arm starts and ends every session and waits between picks (READY to READY, never released; the five-bar's own home would hang the claw 101 mm into the belt). These are the numbers every copy had on 2026-11-15: the claw's TCP 40 mm over the bin's drop (bam_rack_twin full_arm.ready_motors, TCP (0.565, 0.400) m in the bench plane) with the claw plumb (TD4: W1 = L2's angle, W2 +90, W3 0); the five-bar as sim2real's homing ruler had it (Craig 65.246 / 122.791, ready_motors' IK to 0.0005 deg); J1 -12.7 because J1 0 touched the side-table clutter at homed -7 deg (2026-11-14 07:11Z, envelope J1 <= -9 deg; the clutter was cleared 2026-11-15 09:38Z). The rack realises it per power-up as a board record (ready_record.json, which carries this pose's digest). Zach 2026-11-15: a more compact READY that costs less to hold is being chosen in sim.

pose.name: home
pose.why: The five-bar's home in its homed map of record (homed_083647, 2026-11-10: home_joint_rad, Craig 91.01 / -126.438): where fivebar_home ends and the homing routines start their walks (sim2real gff_rung / fullarm_check / fullarm_home HOME_CRAIG_DEG, bam_rack_twin fullarm_comp's 'home'). The full arm never waits here in a session: the claw would hang 101 mm into the belt.
